title: a relative .sm import that is absent from the supplied project fails closed
notes: poc/src/language/README.md: 'SMITHERS1801: a relative .sm import is absent from the supplied project.' The underlying obligation is that failure and requirement rows are computed over the whole supplied module set (specification/requirements.mdx, 'Satisfaction': 'When the compiler knows the complete closure, an unsatisfied capability MUST be a compile error') — a module the compiler cannot see means the closure is not known, so analysis must fail closed rather than assume an empty row. The import here is type-only so the case reports exactly the missing-module rule and not a foreign-value cascade.
